newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: Kia Steel expands production capacity.
newsitem.headline: Kia Steel expands production capacity.

text.p: Kia Steel Co, an affiliate of South Korea's Kia Corp, said it completed on Thursday the expansion of its speciality steel production capacity to 720,000 tonnes a year from 520,000.

Kia Steel invested 924 billion won in the expansion at the plant in the southwestern city of Kunsan. The new facility would make high-value-added products, including stainless tool steel and stainless wire rod.
The company said it expected the expansion to help increase sales to 500 billion won in calendar 1997 from 320.7 billion won last year.
"We aim to be the world's 10th largest specialty steel maker by 2001 with a turnover of one trillion won," spokesman Kwak Kwan-sung said.
